requirements.text: Receptionists can see whether a patient has a portal account and whether it is locked.
requirements.quote: Receptionists shall be able to see, for any patient, whether the patient has a portal account and whether it is locked, so that they can direct the patient appropriately.

requirements.text: The portal must not keep its own appointment book; availability searches and bookings must use the PMS.
requirements.quote: The portal shall not keep its own copy of the appointment book; every availability search and booking shall be made against the PMS.

requirements.text: Only patients already registered at one of the six clinics may use the portal.
requirements.quote: Patients must already be registered at one of the six clinics to use the portal.

requirements.text: A registered patient can create a portal account by verifying identity against PMS details using date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.
requirements.quote: A registered patient shall be able to create a portal account by verifying their identity against the details held in the PMS, using their date of birth, surname, postcode and a one-time code sent to the mobile number held in the PMS.

requirements.text: If no mobile number is recorded, the portal must tell the patient to contact the clinic and must not offer another online identity verification route.
requirements.quote: If a patient has no mobile number recorded in the PMS, the portal shall tell the patient to contact their clinic and shall not offer any other way to verify their identity online.

requirements.text: Patients sign in with email address and password, and must use a second factor on every sign-in from an unseen device.
requirements.quote: A patient shall sign in with an email address and password, and the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

requirements.text: The portal locks an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and unlocks it automatically after thirty minutes.
requirements.quote: The portal shall lock an account after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts and shall unlock it automatically after thirty minutes.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff cannot manually unlock accounts in the first release.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff will not be able to unlock accounts manually in the first release; this was discussed and deliberately left out to avoid creating a social engineering route.

requirements.text: A signed-in session ends after inactivity, with a warning before it ends.
requirements.quote: A signed-in session shall end after a period of inactivity, and the patient shall be warned before it ends.

requirements.text: A carer can book, reschedule and cancel appointments for any dependant linked to their account.
requirements.quote: A carer shall be able to book, reschedule and cancel appointments for any dependant linked to their account.

requirements.text: Only front-desk staff can create a carer-dependant link after checking the carer's authority; patients cannot create links themselves.
requirements.quote: A link between a carer and a dependant shall only be created by front-desk staff after they have checked the carer's authority, and the portal shall not let a patient create such a link themselves.

requirements.text: A carer link for a dependant under sixteen ends automatically on the dependant's sixteenth birthday, with notice to the carer thirty days beforehand.
requirements.quote: A carer link for a dependant under the age of sixteen shall end automatically on the dependant's sixteenth birthday, and the portal shall notify the carer thirty days beforehand.

requirements.text: Links for adult dependants are reviewed periodically.
requirements.quote: Links for adult dependants, for example a patient with a lasting power of attorney in place, are reviewed periodically.

requirements.text: The portal shows only appointment types marked bookable online at the patient's registered site.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show a patient only the appointment types that are marked as bookable online at the patient's registered site.

requirements.text: For physiotherapy follow-ups and travel health consultations, the portal also offers slots at other sites that deliver those services.
requirements.quote: For physiotherapy follow-ups and travel health consultations, the portal shall also offer slots at the other sites that deliver those services.

requirements.text: The portal shows four weeks of availability and lets patients filter by site, clinician, day of the week and time of day.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show availability for the next four weeks and shall let the patient filter by site, clinician, day of the week and time of day.

requirements.text: Portal availability must reflect the PMS appointment book in near real time.
requirements.quote: Availability shown in the portal shall reflect the PMS appointment book in near real time.

requirements.text: Selecting a slot places a five-minute hold so others cannot book it while the patient completes the booking.
requirements.quote: When a patient selects a slot, the portal shall place a hold on it for five minutes so that no other patient or staff member can book it while the patient completes the booking.

requirements.text: If the patient does not confirm within the hold period, the slot is released.
requirements.quote: If the patient does not confirm within the hold period the slot is released.

requirements.text: A patient cannot hold more than two future routine GP appointments at the same time across all sites.
requirements.quote: A patient shall not hold more than two future routine GP appointments at the same time across all sites.

requirements.text: The two-appointment limit does not apply to nurse reviews, immunisations or physiotherapy.
requirements.quote: This limit does not apply to nurse reviews, immunisations or physiotherapy, which are often booked as a series.

requirements.text: The portal does not allow bookings starting less than two hours from the current time.
requirements.quote: The portal shall not allow a booking that starts less than two hours from the current time.

requirements.text: Childhood immunisation appointments can only be booked by a carer for a dependant whose age is within the range set for that immunisation type in the PMS.
requirements.quote: Childhood immunisation appointments shall only be bookable by a carer for a dependant whose age is within the range set for that immunisation type in the PMS.

requirements.text: Before confirming a booking, the portal asks for the appointment reason in a free-text field of up to 200 characters and passes it to the PMS.
requirements.quote: Before confirming a booking, the portal shall ask the patient to state the reason for the appointment in a free-text field of up to 200 characters, which shall be passed to the PMS with the booking.

requirements.text: Every booking screen shows a clear urgent-problem warning with the clinic telephone number and the national urgent care number.
requirements.quote: The portal shall show a clear warning on every booking screen that it must not be used for urgent medical problems, with the telephone number of the clinic and the national urgent care number.

requirements.text: On confirmation, the portal writes the booking to the PMS and only shows the patient confirmation after PMS acceptance.
requirements.quote: When a booking is confirmed, the portal shall write it to the PMS and shall show the patient a confirmation only after the PMS has accepted it.

requirements.text: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.
requirements.quote: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.

requirements.text: A patient can cancel an appointment through the portal up to two hours before its start time.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be able to cancel an appointment through the portal up to two hours before its start time.

requirements.text: A patient can move an appointment to another slot of the same type, and the original slot is released only after the PMS accepts the new booking.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be able to move an appointment to another slot of the same appointment type, and the original slot shall only be released once the new booking has been accepted by the PMS.

requirements.text: When cancelling, the portal asks the patient to choose a reason from a list maintained by practice managers.
requirements.quote: The portal shall ask a patient who cancels to choose a reason from a list maintained by the practice managers.

requirements.text: Appointments booked by telephone are visible in the portal and can be cancelled by the patient in the same way as online appointments.
requirements.quote: Appointments booked by telephone shall be visible in the portal and shall be cancellable by the patient in the same way as appointments booked online.

requirements.text: The portal sends a text message reminder 48 hours before every appointment, whether booked online or by telephone.
requirements.quote: The portal shall send each patient a reminder by text message 48 hours before every appointment, whether it was booked online or by telephone.

requirements.text: A reminder lets the patient cancel by replying to the message or following a link without signing in.
requirements.quote: A reminder shall let the patient cancel the appointment by replying to the message or by following a link, without signing in.

requirements.text: Cancelling through a reminder releases the slot in the same way as cancelling in the portal.
requirements.quote: Cancelling through a reminder releases the slot in the same way as cancelling in the portal.

requirements.text: The portal sends an email confirmation when an appointment is booked, moved or cancelled to the email address on the account that made the change.
requirements.quote: The portal shall send a confirmation by email when an appointment is booked, moved or cancelled, to the email address on the account that made the change.

requirements.text: Where a carer makes the change, the confirmation goes to the carer.
requirements.quote: Where a carer makes the change, the confirmation goes to the carer.

requirements.text: Patients can choose not to receive text reminders, and that choice is recorded in the PMS so it also applies to PMS reminders.
requirements.quote: Patients shall be able to choose not to receive text reminders, and the choice shall be recorded in the PMS so that it also applies to reminders the PMS sends.

requirements.text: A same-day text reminder is sent at 7am for physiotherapy appointments starting after 10am.
requirements.quote: A same-day text reminder is sent at 7am for physiotherapy appointments starting after 10am.

requirements.text: Waiting list offers are sent by text message and email when a matching slot is released.
requirements.quote: Waiting list offer | Text message and email | When a matching slot is released | The patient on the waiting list

requirements.text: A patient who cannot find a suitable slot can join a waiting list for a chosen appointment type and site, stating days of the week and times of day they could attend.
requirements.quote: A patient who cannot find a suitable slot shall be able to join a waiting list for a chosen appointment type and site, stating the days of the week and times of day they could attend.

requirements.text: When a matching slot is released, the portal offers it to waiting-list patients in the order they joined.
requirements.quote: When a slot of that appointment type is released at that site within the patient's stated availability, the portal shall offer it to patients on the waiting list in the order in which they joined.

requirements.text: A waiting-list offer expires if not accepted within a short period, and the slot is then offered to the next patient.
requirements.quote: An offer shall expire if it is not accepted within a short period, and the slot shall then be offered to the next patient on the list.

requirements.text: A patient is removed from a waiting list on accepting an offer, booking a matching appointment themselves, or after 60 days, whichever comes first.
requirements.quote: A patient shall be removed from a waiting list once they accept an offer, book a matching appointment themselves, or after 60 days, whichever comes first.

requirements.text: Practice managers can mark or unmark each appointment type at their own site as bookable online, with changes taking effect within fifteen minutes.
requirements.quote: Practice managers shall be able to mark or unmark each appointment type at their own site as bookable online, and the change shall take effect in the portal within fifteen minutes.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff can see a list of the day's online bookings, cancellations and waiting-list offers for their site, including each patient's stated reason for appointment.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to see a list of the day's online bookings, cancellations and waiting list offers for their site, with the reason for appointment given by each patient.

requirements.text: Front-desk staff can suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range without changing the PMS rota.
requirements.quote: Front-desk staff shall be able to suspend online booking for a single clinician for a date range, for example during unplanned leave, without changing the PMS rota.

requirements.text: The portal provides a monthly report for each site showing online bookings, moves and cancellations, reminders sent, and missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.
requirements.quote: The portal shall provide a monthly report for each site showing the number of appointments booked, moved and cancelled online, the number of reminders sent, and the number of missed appointments for online and telephone bookings separately.

requirements.text: The portal is available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days in advance.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding planned maintenance announced at least five days in advance.

requirements.text: Availability searches return results within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.
requirements.quote: Availability searches shall return results within three seconds for 95% of requests at peak load.

requirements.text: The patient-facing portal meets the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standard.
requirements.quote: The patient-facing portal shall meet the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standard.

requirements.text: The portal is available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible.
requirements.quote: The portal shall be available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible.

requirements.text: The portal stores only the personal data needed for sign-in and reminders and reads other patient details from the PMS when needed.
requirements.quote: The portal shall store only the personal data needed to sign patients in and to send reminders, and shall read all other patient details from the PMS when they are needed.

requirements.text: Every booking, change and cancellation through the portal is recorded in an audit log showing who made it, on whose behalf, and when.
requirements.quote: Every booking, change and cancellation made through the portal shall be recorded in an audit log showing who made it, on whose behalf, and when.

requirements.text: Audit log entries are kept for eight years and cannot be edited by any user, including system administrators.
requirements.quote: Audit log entries shall be kept for eight years and shall not be editable by any user, including system administrators.

requirements.text: Portal accounts unused for two years are deleted, and the patient is warned by email thirty days before deletion.
requirements.quote: Portal accounts that have not been used for two years shall be deleted, and the patient shall be warned by email thirty days before deletion.

requirements.text: Deleting a portal account does not affect the patient's PMS record.
requirements.quote: Deleting a portal account does not affect the patient's record in the PMS.

questions.text: What exact inactivity period must trigger session end, and how much warning must the patient receive before it ends?
questions.quote: A signed-in session shall end after a period of inactivity, and the patient shall be warned before it ends. The workshop did not reach a conclusion on how long the period should be.

questions.text: What does 'periodically' mean for adult dependant links—how often, by whom, and what triggers a review?
questions.quote: Links for adult dependants, for example a patient with a lasting power of attorney in place, are reviewed periodically.

questions.text: What maximum delay is acceptable for 'near real time' so the integration and acceptance tests can be specified?
questions.quote: Availability shown in the portal shall reflect the PMS appointment book in near real time.

questions.text: What exact patient-facing and system behaviour is required when the PMS is unavailable during booking, such as error message, retry, or hold release?
questions.quote: If the PMS is unavailable, the booking should be handled appropriately.

questions.text: Should the appointment reminder be sent 48 hours before, as stated here, or 24 hours before, as the notification table's 'Upcoming appointment' row states?
questions.quote: The portal shall send each patient a reminder by text message 48 hours before every appointment, whether it was booked online or by telephone.

questions.text: What exact expiry period should apply to waiting list offers?
questions.quote: An offer shall expire if it is not accepted within a short period, and the slot shall then be offered to the next patient on the list.

questions.text: Should patients be allowed to book routine GP appointments at a site other than their registered site, and if so under what rules?
questions.quote: Whether patients registered at one site may book routine GP appointments at another site has been discussed but not decided. Two practice managers were in favour and four were against.

questions.text: Should front-desk staff be able to see the patient's stated reason for appointment?
questions.quote: The clinical leads have asked whether the reason for appointment should be visible to front-desk staff at all. The staff list described in section 8 assumes that it is.

questions.text: Which languages must be supported, and is 'where possible' a firm requirement or best effort?
questions.quote: The portal shall be available in English and in the other languages most commonly spoken by registered patients, where possible. The practice managers believe Polish, Urdu and Somali are the most common, but this has not been confirmed from registration data.

questions.text: What password length, complexity, reset, and device-recognition rules must the portal enforce for sign-in?
questions.quote: A patient shall sign in with an email address and password, and the portal shall require a second factor on every sign-in from a device it has not seen before.

questions.text: What counts as account use for the two-year deletion rule—sign-in, booking, or any activity?
questions.quote: Portal accounts that have not been used for two years shall be deleted, and the patient shall be warned by email thirty days before deletion.

questions.text: Does 'hold' in this rule mean appointments already booked, or does it also include the five-minute temporary holds defined in the glossary?
questions.quote: A patient shall not hold more than two future routine GP appointments at the same time across all sites.
